summary: community.docker deprecated support for end-of-life ansible-core versions; its next major release drops ansible-core 2.11 through 2.14.
questions: Will community.docker keep working on ansible-core 2.14?
Which ansible-core versions does the next community.docker major release drop?

answer_card.title: community.docker drops EOL ansible-core
answer_card.answer_md: The next major **community.docker** release no longer supports **ansible-core 2.11, 2.12, 2.13 and 2.14** (all EOL). Upgrade ansible-core before upgrading the collection.
